## nagasim.inputfit.best_fit

```text
best_fit(values, *, candidates: list[str] | None=None, shift: bool=False)
```

The winner of `fit_candidates` -- best AIC, ties broken by KS -- or None when no family could be fit at all.

## nagasim.modelcheck.assert_model

```text
assert_model(path_or_layout, strict: bool=False) -> None
```

pytest helper: `nagasim.modelcheck.assert_model("model.json")` raises AssertionError naming every failed assertion/reality check, so a normal pytest failure report shows what went wrong. An inconclusive result (an assertion's CI straddles the bound) does not raise by default -- it is reported through `warnings.warn` instead -- unless `strict=True`, which treats it as a failure too.
